PORT.description: serve: the port the HTTP server listens on.

OSF_DATA.description: serve: the folder of the embedded PostgreSQL (PGlite) when INTAKE_DATABASE_URL is not set.

OSF_NOW.description: The current time, like 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, for the time a work item and a request were received. Default: the clock.

INTAKE_API_TOKEN.description: serve: the token that callers of /v1 send as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Required. mcp: the token it sends to the server. Required.

INTAKE_DATABASE_URL.description: serve: the PostgreSQL database of the work items, schema intake. Default: an embedded PostgreSQL in OSF_DATA.

INTAKE_NATS_URL.description: serve: the NATS server for work.received@v1 on osf.work.received.v1. Unset: no events.

INTAKE_SLACK_ADAPTER.description: serve: the command line of the channel port's slack adapter, which reads Slack's deliveries and replies (ADR 0063).

INTAKE_SLACK_URL.description: serve: base URL of the Slack Web API, ending in a slash: the adapter's CHANNEL_API_URL. Default: the adapter's, https://slack.com/api/.

INTAKE_SLACK_TOKEN.description: serve: Slack bot token with chat:write, the adapter's CHANNEL_TOKEN. Set, the server takes Slack's events at /slack/events.

INTAKE_SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET.description: serve: the signing secret of the Slack app, the adapter's CHANNEL_SIGNING_SECRET. Required with INTAKE_SLACK_TOKEN.

INTAKE_URL.description: mcp: the base URL of intake serve, like http://localhost:8080. Required.

INTAKE_REQUESTER.description: mcp: the person the agent works for, <source>:<id> like github:varun, the requester of its work. Required.
